remarks: Welcome to 102 Vern Lane! This charming home was built in 1962. It has been owned by the same family for the last 58 years & has been meticulously maintained. This midcentury property blends solid historic craftsmanship with many updated mechanics, providing the next owner with peace of mind and a move-in-ready foundation. Spanning a comfortable 1,568 sq ft of functional interior living space on a well-proportioned lot. As you approach the home, the pride of long-term ownership is immediately evident. The stamped concrete sidewalk leads to the maintenance free vinyl railings and newer full glass front door.   Step across the threshold to discover a welcoming layout with original hardwood floors and large replaced windows throughout. The living room is generously sized and offers great natural light. The eat in kitchen has solid wood cabinets, stainless steel cabinets & plenty of room to cook. The adjacent formal dining room offers ample space for entertaining & built-in cabinetry.  The first floor has an additional versatile room that can be used as a 4th bedroom, office or playroom. The second floor has 3 bedrooms with ample closet space & easy access to the central full bathroom. The basement offers great storage & updated mechanics including 150 amp electric panel (2025), newer furnace, A/C and HWT, glass block windows & a half bath that could easily be expanded to a full bath.  The convenient attached garage has an epoxy floor &  overhead garage doors on the front and back.  The custom garage doors screens allow you to expand your outdoor space in the warmer months.  The rear garage door provides easy access to the fully fenced yard and patio.  Close to shopping, dining, restaurants & all area attractions. For leisure & recreation, you are just a short trip away from the beautiful trails & green spaces at Stiglmeier Park, Raymond Park and Reinstein Woods Nature Preserve.  Do not miss the opportunity to plant your roots in a house that truly stands the test of time. 102 Vern Lane is ready to welcome you home.
